BACKGROUND The University of Rhode Island is seeking a dedicated and qualified vendor to provide emergency and routine utility maintenance and repair services for all underground and above -ground utility systems , excluding electrical , located on the Kingston, Narragansett Bay and W.
Alton Jones campuses .
These critical systems include steam, water (potable and non-potable), sewage, storm water, natural gas, propane and heating oil.
The Kingston campus consists of 197 buildings totaling over 4 million square feet with miles of underground utility systems.
URI owned utility systems on the Kingston campus include a central steam plant, steam and condensate distribution/return network s, Five natural gas distribution networks, sewer collection system with four sewer pump stations, potable water supply and distribution, oil and propane fuel storage tanks for heating systems and a stormwater collection system.
The 153 acre Narragansett Bay Campus consists of 41 buildings and 326,000 square feet.

Utilities include natural gas supplied by RIE and distributed by URI owned piping network, potable water provided by the town and distributed by URI owned piping network, sewer collected by URI owned piping network and sent to the town for treatment, stormwater collection sy stem and oil and propane fuel storage for heating and generators.
The W.
Alton Jones campus is a rural campus in West Greenwich, RI and composed of 30 buildings.
Utilities include three small public water systems, septic systems, propane and oil storage for heating systems.
The selected vendor must have a thorough understanding of connection and repair methods for each of these utilities and an integral understanding of each of the university’s utility systems is necessary for undertaking the scope of work described in Section B of this solicitation.
The vendor shall demonstrate troubleshooting of utility outages and methods of providing control of the utility network and temporary service.
As such, the selected vendor(s) will be required to study and understand the universi ty’s utility systems within the first 6 months of the contract’s award date.

The selected vendor(s) will be required to provide routine and emergency service for pipefitter, steamfitter and plumbing services, along with all construction equipment, excavation services and materials required to perform the necessary task/repair.
Services shall also include investigation as necessary to ensure proper repair (locating, camera work, transit level, etc).
